There are faint outlines of other marine life or debris in the background and foreground rocks.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle granularity of real shark skin, though this is partly due to image compression.
Significant motion blur and lack of detail in the background elements and foreground rocks suggest either camera motion or AI-generated smoothing artifacts.
The very tip of the caudal fin blends slightly into the background water without a sharp edge, indicating minor boundary definition issues.

alignment_reasoning: The image demonstrates excellent class conformance. All testable anatomical checkpoints (cephalofoil shape, eye position, fin shapes, body proportions) are present and accurate. The subject is unmistakably a hammerhead shark.
artifact_reasoning: While the anatomy is correct, the image suffers from low-fidelity rendering artifacts. The skin lacks realistic micro-texture (appearing smooth/plastic), and there is noticeable blur and softness in the background and object boundaries, reducing the overall photorealism score.
